map.标准差与方差 使用指南: Standard Deviation and Variance User Guide
map.输入一组数值并选择类型（1 为样本、2 为总体），计算样本或总体标准差、方差以及: Enter a set of values and choose the type (1 for sample, 2 for population) to compute the standard deviation, variance, and coefficient of variation CV, measuring dispersion and relative fluctuation so data in different units can be compared.
map.方差 s² = Σ(xᵢ − x̄)² / (n − 1 或 n)；标准差 s: Variance s² = Σ(xᵢ − x̄)² / (n − 1 or n); standard deviation s = √s²; CV = s / |x̄| × 100%
map.先求均值 x̄，再算各值离差平方和，除以自由度即得方差：样本用 n − 1（无偏: First find the mean x̄, then sum the squared deviations and divide by the degrees of freedom to get the variance: n − 1 for a sample (unbiased) and n for a population. The standard deviation is the square root of the variance and shares the data's units; the coefficient of variation CV is the standard deviation divided by the absolute mean times 100%, which helps compare across units. This page fixes n at 7, using a denominator of 6 for the sample and 7 for the population.
map.检验数据是否近似正态（Shapiro/K-S 思路）。: Test whether the data is approximately normal (along the lines of Shapiro or K-S).
map.非正态时改用非参方法。: For non-normal data, switch to a nonparametric method.
map.偏度峰度判正态: Judge Normality from Skewness and Kurtosis
map.：样本偏度≈0、超额峰度≈0、且 QQ plot 近似直线 → 可视为正态，可用: : with sample skewness ≈ 0, excess kurtosis ≈ 0, and a QQ plot close to a straight line, the data can be treated as normal and a t-test used.
map.：偏度 1.5、峰度 4 → 非正态，宜用 Wilcoxon/Mann-Whit: : skewness 1.5 and kurtosis 4 mean the data is not normal, so a nonparametric test such as Wilcoxon or Mann-Whitney is appropriate.
map.正态性检验 p>0.05 就正态？: Does p>0.05 in a Normality Test Prove Normality?
map.不，只是\"未检出偏离\"，大样本即使轻微偏离也显著、小样本则不敏感，需结合图判: No — it only means "no deviation detected." With a large sample even a slight deviation is significant, while a small sample is insensitive, so judge it together with the plots.
map.非正态必须换方法？: Must I Switch Methods for Non-Normal Data?
map.大样本下许多检验对偏离稳健（CLT），或做变换（log/Box-Cox）后用参数: With large samples many tests are robust to deviation (CLT), or you transform the data (log/Box-Cox) and use a parametric method.
